parameters.name: CasterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the LIVE console, find the ID on the Cloud Production Studio page. To go to this page, choose **LIVE** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio**.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The time must be in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format and in UTC.

parameters.name: EpisodeType
parameters.description:
The type of the node. Valid values:

- **Resource**: video source.

- **Component**: component.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of programs on each page.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The time must be in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format and in UTC.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the program. Valid values:

- **0**: not started

- **1**: playing

- **2**: finished
